about_the_game:
• Brought to you by the team behind the award-winning Battle Chef Brigade

  • Embark on more than 50 plot-driven and character-focused missions from old friends gone awry to psychedelic dream conflicts

  • 5 vs 5 card battle keeps the game fast-paced, streamlined and strategically rewarding

  • ​​Customize your ship's hull with the Pilot Placement System to optimize your battle strategy and give your pilots the edge they need to win

  • Experience a personalized narrative depending on which Factions you support and relationships you build

  • More than 50 fully voiced characters to befriend

LEAD A RAGTAG CREW IN THIS NARRATIVE DECKBUILDER

Embark on a heartfelt journey through the stars on the USS Zephyr, joining Captain Heathcliff and his ragtag crew as they search the galaxy for fabled Relic Suits. Sojourn through monster-infested galactic wilds, leading your crew through danger, tragedy, and comedic sci-fi shenanigans.

Lead your crew on and off the battlefield, learning about their dynamic personalities and playstyles as you progress. Battle Suit Aces keeps track of your gameplay and narrative choices, personalizing each playthrough. Strengthen your relationships with specialized Factions and their pilots to directly impact the narrative.

The Second Voice is calling. Will you listen?

YOUR CARDS ARE YOUR CREW

Join Patchworks as they travel the galaxy in search of more than just ancient alien mecha in a tale of friendship, belonging, and fighting an impossible fight. Along the way, forge bonds with space pirates, paranormal investigators, and starball athletes to build out your crew of aces, who double as cards in your deck. Get to know your crew’s strengths and strategically deploy them in battle. Uncover the rich lives of the more than 50 fully voiced characters and learn what makes them tick.

Will you hit every enemy at once with the boisterous Daciana or target the heart of the problem with the analytical Yan? Some pilot abilities play off each other, inviting you to try new pilot combinations on your battle belt.

CRAFT MESMERIZING MECHA BATTLE SUITS

Use your repertoire to overcome fearsome enemies with unique card abilities and synergies, including the ever-encroaching Frenzied. Acquire resources and craft specialized mods for your pilots’ Suits to defend your Ship in streamlined 5 on 5 battles. Every pilot’s mech can be upgraded with mods that increase stats or add new abilities.

Mod and battle slots are limited, so choose carefully, leveraging the Pilot Placement system. You’ll need a varied deck to counter Battle Suit Aces' suite of villains, who have dangerous abilities and synergies of their own. Your unique build and use of the Pilot Placement system lets you form your ideal strategy and maximize impact.

A CHARMING ANIME-INSPIRED WORLD TO EXPLORE

Enter into the hand-crafted Battle Suit Aces world, filled with thoughtful and stylish characters prepared to dazzle. Charming, vibrant art reminiscent of your favorite anime comes to life while the orchestral soundtrack welcomes you into the whimsically warm atmosphere.

short_description: Battle Suit Aces is a charming narrative deckbuilder. You'll recruit, befriend, and upgrade your mech pilots on a heartfelt hunt for fabled alien superweapons: the Relic Suits. Command them across monster-infested galactic wilds through danger, tragedy, and comedic sci-fi shenanigans.
